question.text: Let each of the two ellipses $\mathrm{E}_{1}: \frac{x^{2}}{a^{2}}+\frac{y^{2}}{b^{2}}=1,(a>b)$ and $\mathrm{E}_{2}: \frac{x^{2}}{\mathrm{~A}^{2}}+\frac{y^{2}}{\mathrm{~B}^{2}}=1,(\mathrm{~A}<\mathrm{B})$ have eccentricity $\frac{4}{5}$.
